gloss: having an idea; clue; something that comes to mind

definitions.gloss: having an idea; clue; something that comes to mind
definitions.explanation: A vague idea or recollection about something, often used when someone might know the cause, location, or person involved. Frequently used with ある (to have) or ない (to not have).

examples.japanese: {心当|こころあ}たり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{心当|こころあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I have no idea who the culprit might be.

examples.japanese: ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくした⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{心当|こころあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧なら、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{探|さが}し→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: If you have any idea where you lost your wallet, let's go look for it right away.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the patterns {心当|こころあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have an idea/clue) or {心当|こころあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have no idea). Commonly used in conversations about mysteries, lost items, or unknown causes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {心当|こころあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have an idea about something)
- {心当|こころあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have no idea)
- {心当|こころあ}たり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (do you have any idea? — polite)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{心当|こころあ}たり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have an idea about ~)
